name: medilink
description: MediLink - SAP Hackfest 2026 prototype (synthetic data). CAP + HANA Cloud + OR-Tools on free SAP BTP plans.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mock-medisoft install && npm --prefix simulator install && node scripts/py.js . -m pip install -r matcher/requirements.txt -r connector/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:medisoft && npm run test:simulator && npm run test:matcher && npm run test:connector
